title: fix(sieve-native): log regex execution errors instead of silent fail-open
description: str_matches_regex_pat in crates/sieve-native/src/evaluator.rs line 435 calls re.is_match(value).unwrap_or(false). fancy_regex::Regex::is_match returns Err when the engine exceeds execution limits (catastrophic backtracking / ReDoS guard). Swallowing the error and returning false means a Sieve :regex rule that triggers the backtracking limit silently fails open — spam with a payload designed to cause backtracking passes through the filter without any indication of failure. Fix: log the error before returning false so operators can detect that a Sieve script has a vulnerable regex pattern.
